notes.title: Cookie Clicker on PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch
notes.content:
[b]Cookie Clicker is now available on Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo Switch![/b] It is a full port of the PC game, published by our partners at Playsaurus. You can pick it up on your preferred platform through the links below, or visit [url=https://cookieclicker.com]cookieclicker.com[/url] for the full list of everything you can officially play Cookie Clicker on! The console versions are about $5 or equivalent in your local currency (and as always, the browser version remains free).

[list]
[*] [url=https://cookieclicker.playsaurus.com/store/playstation][b]Cookie Clicker on PlayStation[/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://cookieclicker.playsaurus.com/store/xbox][b]Cookie Clicker on Xbox[/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://cookieclicker.playsaurus.com/store/switch][b]Cookie Clicker on Nintendo Switch[/b][/url]
[/list]

We've got a [url=https://discordapp.com/channels/412363381891137536/1374922847243468860]new thread on the discord server[/url] for any bugs or feedback relating to the console versions. We've already got some performance fixes lined up; expect patches as we get the kinks out!

Thank you for supporting what we make, we're already planning the next content updates! New features will release on browser first, then Steam and consoles.

-Orteil

tags.feature: Cookie Clicker is now available on Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo Switch!

notes.title: Language patch!
notes.content:
[h1]Language update[/h1]
[list]
[*] Patch 2.053 adds support for the [b]Norwegian[/b] and [b]Danish[/b] languages on PC and Mac.
This brings the game's language selection to [b]15 languages[/b]!
[/list]
[h1]Idler Fest[/h1]
Steam is currently hosting [b]Idler Fest[/b], celebrating everything idle and incremental!
We're often cited as one of the games that popularized the genre, first launching for web browsers in 2013. As such, we couldn't afford to miss out on celebrating with everyone.
[h3]Cookie Clicker is 66% off on Steam until February 10th![/h3]
That's a historical low! It's the perfect time to gift Cookie Clicker to a friend or foe who could stand to see their productivity plummet. Spread the good word! Send it to your northern friends and single-handedly lower Norway's GDP!

Don't forget to check out all the other games on offer for Idler Fest too! There's some really good ones in there and we couldn't be prouder that some of them mention us as an inspiration.

[h1]What's next[/h1]
We're still making progress on the dungeons minigame, UI overhaul, and QoL changes. Stay tuned!

tags.feature: Patch 2.053 adds support for the Norwegian and Danish languages on PC and Mac.

notes.title: v. 2.052: Cookie Clicker gets you
notes.content:
Full changelog in this update:

[list]
[*]added the final, 20th building
[*][i](currently, no more buildings are planned beyond this one; there are still many more updates to come, but future patches will focus on adding minigames to the existing buildings along with other features!)[/i]
[*]added another tier of upgrades and achievements
[*]updated flavored milk icons
[*]added visual cue for shimmering veil
[*]touched up old Santa sprites
[*]removed Discord rich presence support (plugin currently broken)
[*]new heavenly upgrade that lets you trade presents with other players
[*][b]Cookie Clicker turns 10 years old this year. Thank you for clicking cookies with us![/b]

[/list]

We hope you have fun with the new building! It's got some unique customizable flair.
-Orteil

notes.title: v. 2.048: Cookie Clicker gets smart
notes.content:
Full changelog in this update:

[list]
[*]added a new building
[*]added a new tier of upgrades and achievements
[*]added a few new heavenly upgrades
[*]added the jukebox
[*]the 3 secret heavenly upgrades now rely on how many times the relevant digit is present in total, rather than at the end
[*]backgrounds overhauled; extra options for the background selector
[*]extra options for the golden cookie sound selector
[*]the bank minigame now tells you the value you previously bought a stock at
[*]the bank minigame flow is a little more exciting
[*]new option to disable your game activity showing up in Discord
[*]launch errors now provide the option to restart without mods
[/list]

Stay tuned for future news! We still have a whole lot more in store!
-Orteil

notes.title: v. 2.043: Cookie Clicker Steam Workshop update
notes.content:
Full changelog in this update:

[list]
[*]added Steam Workshop support (lets you install mods and upload your own)
[*]added Korean language support
[*]added back "short numbers" option for non-english languages (uses english terms for the time being)
[*]added tooltips on achievement notifications
[*]added Discord rich presence support
[*]Christmas content update coming soon!
[/list]

This should be the last "technical" update focused on Steam-specific features. Future updates will revolve around new content and new gameplay features.

We're excited to see what you folks come up with using the Workshop. Later on, we may refine the modding tools further as the community's needs become clearer.

Thank you so much for playing Cookie Clicker!
-Orteil

notes.title: Cookie Clicker patch increases compatibility with cheats
notes.content:
Cookie Clicker is out on Steam, and the player counts are going up just like our cookie production numbers. But be sure to actually close the game every now and then, because there are patches to be downloaded, and the first of them is available today. One of the more notable changes in this version improves support for cheats.

This patch fixes "possible audio-induced memory leaks associated with autoclicking", so you can safely make use of your automatic clicker. (It's a single-player game with no leaderboards, so who cares, right?) Developer Orteil says that Steam Workshop support is "underway as well since the local mods seem to be working good", so expect more non-standard ways of clicking cookies to be accessible soon.

This patch has also "fixed that one milk-related achievement", so you can actually resize your window to get the cookie dunked. You can see the full patch notes here, but it's mostly a load of smaller bug fixes, addressing issues with the Steam overlay, options displays, music cues, and closing the game.

Read the rest of the story...
